name: Full finding list
claim_class: A deliverable that runs an automated or human reviewer over the work and then reports on the review.
proof_obligation: The report must include the reviewer's complete finding list, every severity level, Low and Info included, each with an ID, severity, description, and disposition. A deferral is a proposal for someone else to adjudicate out of band; the agent never marks a finding deferred on its own authority. The hook checks one thing mechanically: that the finding list holds an entry marked Low or Info, or says in so many words that there were none. It does not check that each finding carries an id, a severity, a description, and a disposition, though a reader should expect all four. Whether a finding was dropped before the list was written is not mechanically checkable and stays a human judgement.
failure_mode: A finding gets summarized away before it reaches review, the same failure class as a test quietly excluded from a green count. The report reads clean precisely because the item carrying the risk was the one left out.
origin_incident: No single recorded event is documented for this rule. It generalizes a recurring pattern instead: an agent's own summary of a reviewer's output drops the lower-severity findings, and the boundary the review was meant to cross only works if the reviewer's full output crosses it, not a filtered version of it.
